title: Set up monitoring and alerts for a service
summary: Get a standard dashboard, alerts that page your on-call engineer and log shipping for a new service, before it takes production traffic.

resources.title: Dashboard and alert templates
resources.description: Grafana dashboards and alert rules for HTTP services, workers and batch jobs.

resources.title: Skill: add monitoring for a service
resources.description: Generates the dashboard and alert files from your service id and opens the pull request.

prerequisites.title: Service registered in the service catalogue
prerequisites.description: The dashboard and the on-call schedule are named after the service id.

prerequisites.title: The service exposes health and metrics endpoints
prerequisites.description: /healthz and /metrics, as the platform libraries do by default.

actors.name: You
actors.description: An engineer of the team that runs the service.

steps.title: Add the dashboard and alert rules
instructions: Copy the template for your kind of service to services/<service-id>/.
Set the service id, the tier and the PagerDuty schedule.
Keep the four standard alerts: errors, response time, saturation and availability.

steps.title: Check thresholds and paging
steps.description: The team checks that alerts page only for what needs a person at night, and that the thresholds fit the tier.

steps.title: Create the on-call schedule
instructions: In PagerDuty, create a schedule named after the service id.
Add at least two people per week.
Link the schedule to the service in PagerDuty.

steps.title: Send a test alert
instructions: In Grafana, open the alert rule 'availability' and press 'Test'.
Check that the on-call engineer is paged and acknowledges.
Check the dashboard shows data for the last hour.
steps.outcome: Dashboard, alerts and on-call in place
